stock.description: Wai Chun Bio-Technology Limited operates as an investment holding company, primarily focusing on the production and distribution of modified starches and various other biochemical products across the People's Republic of China. Additionally, the firm engages in the trading of electronic components, electrical appliances, and a diverse range of footwear, encompassing athletic, sport-style, work, safety, golf, and other functional shoes. The company was formerly named Wai Chun Mining Industry Group Company Limited before officially adopting its current identity in September 2019. Its principal corporate offices are situated in Admiralty, Hong Kong.
